AI Overview
Orbit Kick is a casual, one-button browser arcade game published by Azgames where the goal is to kick a soccer ball as far as possible rather than play traditional matches. You can play it directly online through platforms like Orbit Kick. 
Core Gameplay & Loop
One-Button Controls: Click or tap at the right moment to stop a moving power and angle meter. 
orbitkick.io
 +1
Distance to Coins: The further your ball travels, the more coins you earn. 
orbitkick.io
Upgrades: Spend your coins on three main stats to push your distance further:
Power: Increases your initial launch strength.
Bounce: Improves how the ball bounces and maintains momentum across terrain.
Offline Earnings: Boosts passive coin collection when you are away. 
orbitkick.io
 +1
Milestones & Levels: Hitting distance milestones like 1,000m or 2,000m unlocks new levels, ball skins, and global landmarks (such as Russia, Egypt, and Brazil). Scoring a goal directly in-game also doubles your coin reward for that run.
